Frank J. Russo

No Party Affiliation candidate for Governor and Lieutenant Governor, Florida · Open seat

Entrepreneur, developer and insurance executive (New Smyrna Beach)

Frank J. Russo is an entrepreneur, developer and insurance executive from New Smyrna Beach. He announced his campaign for governor as an independent (NPA) candidate on April 14, 2026. He appears on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as No Party Affiliation.

Where Russo stands

Affordability / cost of living
Says Floridians are struggling with rising housing and insurance costs. His 'People First — Humanity Over the Dollar' campaign proposes restoring affordability, stabilizing insurance and expanding workforce opportunities.
Housing
Proposes a housing push for working families in all 67 counties, paid for with private capital and private builders and no new government dollars. He asked President Trump to bring builders to the table.
Education / teacher pay
Supports raising the average teacher salary to $75,000.
Property insurance
Says he wants to guarantee Floridians affordable coverage, and lists stabilizing insurance as a key campaign initiative.

Background

  • Occupation: entrepreneur, developer and insurance executive
  • Based in New Smyrna Beach, Florida
  • Changed party registration from Republican to Independent in 2022
  • Announced NPA candidacy for governor April 14, 2026
  • Raised more than $860,000 (per WLRN, Oct. 2026)
